# PheromoneTrailTopology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A virtual topology layer where stigmergic pheromone gradients are overlaid on the physical interconnect to guide routing and load balancing. Allows adaptive, emergent path selection in network-on-chip or data center topologies, improving resilience and efficiency under varying traffic.
